Question
========
You reference a figure in your text with `@fig-scores`, but the figure's actual chunk label is `#| label: fig-score`
(missing the final "s"). What happens when you render the document?

Answerlist
----------
* Quarto automatically matches the closest label and resolves the reference correctly.
* The reference fails to resolve, and the rendered document shows the broken reference text or a placeholder instead of a number.
* Rendering stops with a fatal error and no document is produced.
* The figure is renumbered to match the reference automatically.

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Wrong: Quarto requires an exact label match; it does not guess or auto-correct mismatched labels.
* Correct: a cross-reference only resolves if it exactly matches an existing label; otherwise it shows the raw reference text or a placeholder instead of a number.
* Wrong: a mismatched cross-reference does not stop rendering entirely; the rest of the document still renders.
* Wrong: labels are not automatically adjusted to match an incorrect reference.
